examples.arabic: بنتها ليلى، كانت دايماً بتساعد بتقديم الأكل، وبتتأكد إنو الكل أكل منيح.
examples.english: Her daughter, Layla, always helped serve the food, making sure everyone had eaten well.
examples.transliteration: Bentha Layla, kaanat dayman btsa'ed b taqdim el-akl, w bteta'akad inno l-kull akal mneeh.
examples.storyTitle: The Warmth of a Damascene Friday Gathering

examples.arabic: لينا بسرعة حَسَبِت إنهم رح يقدروا يشتروا أشياء كتير تانية إذا دبروا مصاريهم منيح وما صرفوا كتير على شي واحد.
examples.english: Lina quickly calculated that they would be able to buy many other things if they managed their money well and didn't spend too much on one item.
examples.transliteration: Leena b-sur'a hasabit innahom rah yiqdaru yishtaru ashyaa' kteer taniyeh iza dabbaroo masarihom mneeh w ma sarrafo kteer 'ala shi wahed.
examples.storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

examples.arabic: لما فتح سامي الكيس، لقى بين حبات الطحين مفتاح مصدي ورسالة قديمة مكتوبة بخط إيد بيعرفه كتير منيح.
examples.english: When Sami opened the bag, he found among the grains of flour a rusty key and an old letter written in a handwriting he knew very well.
examples.transliteration: Lamma fataH Sami al-kis, la'a bayn habbat al-tHin miftah mSaddi wa-risala qadima maktouba bi-khatt id bi-ya'rifo ktir mniH.
examples.storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

examples.arabic: ماما قالت الثلاجة ما عم تشتغل منيح وهالوضع صار صعب
examples.english: Mom said the fridge isn't working well and this situation became difficult.
examples.transliteration: Mama qalat el tallajeh ma am tishtaghel mneeh w hal wada' sar sa'ab.

examples.arabic: فريقنا بلش اللعب مش منيح بس كان في لاعب طويل كتير
examples.english: Our team started playing not well, but there was a very tall player
examples.transliteration: farīqna ballash il-laʿeb mish mnīḥ bas kān fī lāʿeb ṭawīl ktīr

examples.arabic: ستي كانت توزع اللبن وتوصينا ناكل منيح ونشرب الشاي السخن
examples.english: My grandmother was serving the yogurt and advising us to eat well and drink the hot tea.
examples.transliteration: Sitti kanat tuwazzi' al-laban w tuwassina na'kul mnīh w nashrab ash-shay as-sukhn.
